payload.name: Web Performance Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Web Performance Insights runs Lighthouse performance audits on web pages through its tool service, displays scores and Core Web Vitals with historical trends, retrieves real-user Chrome UX Report field data, compares or benchmarks multiple pages head-to-head, provides AI-powered recommendations to improve specific metrics, and exports audit results as downloadable PDF reports.
payload.longDescription: Web Performance Insights 通过其工具服务对网页运行 Lighthouse 性能审计，展示评分、Core Web Vitals 核心网页指标及历史趋势，检索真实用户 Chrome UX Report 现场数据，对多个页面进行并排比较或基准测试，提供由 AI 支持的具体指标优化建议，并将审计结果导出为可下载的 PDF 报告。

payload.name: Veille
payload.description: 电子邮件和 VAT 验证
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Veille is an email, domain, phone, IP, VAT, and IBAN validation API for ChatGPT. Check signups, invoices, and traffic before you trust them.

Email validation flags disposable inboxes, role accounts, and a 0-100 risk score. Email qualification adds SMTP and catch-all. Domain checks disposable and MX health. Phone validation covers E.164 carrier and virtual numbers. IP reputation detects VPN, proxy, Tor, and datacenter. VAT uses VIES. IBAN returns bank and BIC. Exchange rates come from the ECB.

Sign in with your Veille account when you connect. Calls use the same credits and quotas as app.veille.io.
payload.longDescription:
Veille 是面向 ChatGPT 的电子邮件、域名、电话、IP、VAT 和 IBAN 验证 API。在信任注册、发票和流量之前，先对其进行检查。

电子邮件验证会标记一次性邮箱、角色账户，并提供 0-100 风险评分。电子邮件资质检查还包括 SMTP 和 catch-all。域名检查一次性域名和 MX 状态。电话验证涵盖 E.164 运营商及虚拟号码。IP 信誉检测 VPN、代理、Tor 和数据中心。VAT 使用 VIES。IBAN 会返回银行和 BIC。汇率来自 ECB。

连接时请使用你的 Veille 账户登录。调用使用的额度和配额与 app.veille.io 相同。

payload.summaryOriginal: Review pull requests and merge requests
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse and review pull requests and merge requests in Codex.
payload.longDescription: 在 Codex 中浏览和审查拉取请求与合并请求。

payload.name: Componecat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Componecat is your organization's software catalog: every system, service, library, and API you run, with owners, dependencies, documentation, and endpoints in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT direct access to that catalog.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your real software landscape: which team owns the billing service, what depends on the auth API, where the runbook for the payments gateway lives, or which endpoints a component exposes. Search takes precise filters, so one question can cover a whole slice of the catalog. Documentation for each component is available in full, including sections synced from Git, so you can read it and reason about it without leaving the conversation.

You can also keep the catalog current from chat: add or update components, record relationships, attach documentation links, and review recent activity.

Componecat's own product documentation is included too, so ChatGPT can explain how the platform works and walk you through it.

A Componecat account is required. Catalogs are private to your organization, and you sign in with your existing account when connecting.
payload.longDescription:
Componecat 是您组织的软件目录：您运行的每个系统、服务、库和 API，以及对应负责人、依赖项、文档和端点，全部集中一处。此插件让 ChatGPT 直接访问该目录。

用自然语言提问，获取真实软件版图中的答案：计费服务由哪个团队负责、哪些组件依赖身份验证 API、支付网关的运行手册在哪里，或某组件暴露哪些端点。搜索支持精确筛选，因此一个问题即可覆盖目录中的完整切片。每个组件的文档都可完整访问，包括从 Git 同步的章节，您无需离开对话即可阅读并进行推理。

您还可以在聊天中保持目录更新：添加或更新组件、记录关系、附加文档链接并查看近期活动。

Componecat 自身产品文档也包含在内，因此 ChatGPT 可以解释平台工作方式并引导您使用。

需要 Componecat 账户。目录对您的组织私有，连接时使用现有账户登录。

payload.name: 방위사업 법령 도우미
payload.summaryOriginal: 방위사업 관련 공개 법령과 판례 검색
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
방위사업 업무와 관련된 공개 법령, 행정규칙, 판례 및 결정례를 검색하고 질문과 관련된 문서명과 조문·판단 근거를 확인하도록 돕습니다.

국가법령정보센터 Open API와 방위사업청 공개 자료를 활용하며, 개인 개발자가 독립적으로 운영합니다. 
방위사업청·법제처·OpenAI가 제작하거나 후원·승인한 서비스가 아닙니다.

조회 결과는 업무 검토를 위한 참고자료입니다. 최종 판단은 담당자가 원문과 사실관계를 확인 후 판단 바랍니다.

payload.name: dbt

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your Retool environment remotely. Build, edit, and deploy apps, and perform administrative tasks.

payload.name: Cortex — Semantic Memory
payload.description: 为 AI 提供共享记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cortex gives ChatGPT a durable memory that survives across conversations. Save decisions and notes, search them by meaning, and get a synthesized recall of what's known on a topic — always with traceable sources. When new information contradicts what you saved, Cortex flags the conflict instead of silently overwriting it. Your data stays bound to your own subscription account. A SKYNETLAB product, patent-protected and in production.
payload.longDescription: Cortex 为 ChatGPT 提供可跨对话保留的持久记忆。保存决策和笔记，按含义搜索，并获取对某个主题已知信息的综合回顾——始终附有可追溯的来源。当新信息与已保存内容冲突时，Cortex 会标记冲突，而不会悄然覆盖旧内容。你的数据仅与你自己的订阅账户绑定。此产品由 SKYNETLAB 开发，受专利保护，已投入生产使用。

payload.name: AgentiSend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AgentiSend is a transactional email API: send through verified domains with a message log, a free preflight that runs every gate a real send runs, and refusals that name the fix. Built so an agent can send on your behalf without ever exceeding a budget a person set. Unsolicited mail is refused by design; there is no tool for it.
payload.longDescription: AgentiSend是一款事务性邮件API：通过已验证的域名发送邮件，提供消息日志、执行真实发送全部检查关卡的免费预检查，以及明确指出修复方法的拒绝说明。它旨在让智能体代表你发送邮件，同时绝不超出人为设定的预算。系统按设计拒绝未经请求的邮件，也没有用于发送这类邮件的工具。

payload.name: Spacefast
payload.description: 发布并分享 AI 创作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Publish the pages, reports, dashboards, and other artifacts you create with ChatGPT and get a link to share them. Spacefast lets you update existing sites, manage access, connect custom domains, and view or restore earlier versions. Connect your Spacefast account to manage your team's Spaces from the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 发布你使用 ChatGPT 创建的页面、报告、仪表板和其他作品，并获取可分享的链接。Spacefast 让你更新现有网站、管理访问权限、连接自定义域名，并查看或恢复早期版本。连接你的 Spacefast 账户，即可在对话中管理团队的 Spaces。

payload.name: Samva
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Samva helps product teams inspect email readiness and delivery activity, send transactional email, and manage domains, senders, webhooks, templates, scheduled messages, and campaigns through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Samva 帮助产品团队通过 ChatGPT 检查电子邮件就绪状态和投递活动、发送事务性电子邮件，并管理域名、发件人、webhook、模板、定时消息和营销活动。

payload.name: Light Remote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Light Remote lets users connect ChatGPT to explicitly authorized devices they own, inspect device topology and effective policy, open durable sessions, work with files and Git, run bounded commands and managed processes, use real PTY/ConPTY terminals, recover job output after interruptions, and manage Main/Fleet device authority without silently switching targets.
payload.longDescription: Light Remote 让用户可以将 ChatGPT 连接到自己明确授权的设备，检查设备拓扑和有效策略，开启持久会话，处理文件和 Git，运行受限命令及托管进程，使用真实 PTY/ConPTY 终端，在中断后恢复作业输出，并管理 Main/Fleet 设备权限，而不会悄悄切换目标设备。

payload.name: Impreza Host
payload.description: 部署应用并管理服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Impreza Host is privacy-first offshore hosting. Connect your account and work with your infrastructure right in the conversation: list your servers, deploy an app from the curated catalog or straight from a git repository, follow the deploy and read container logs when something fails, manage domains and DNS records, control VPS power, snapshots and backups, and check invoices and balance.

Every tool acts only on the account you authenticate with, and the OAuth scope you grant (read, deploy or manage) decides what is callable. Read-only tools are labelled as such; anything that erases a disk, interrupts a live machine or affects billing is labelled destructive, so it can be confirmed with you before it runs. Purchases are completed on our checkout page, not inside the chat.
payload.longDescription:
Impreza Host 提供以隐私为先的离岸托管服务。关联账户后，你可以直接在对话中管理基础设施：列出服务器，从精选目录或 Git 仓库部署应用，在部署过程中查看进度，并在发生故障时阅读容器日志；管理域名和 DNS 记录；控制 VPS 电源、快照和备份；以及查看发票和余额。

每个工具仅操作你认证的账户，授予的 OAuth 权限范围（读取、部署或管理）决定可以调用哪些功能。只读工具会明确标注；擦除磁盘、中断运行中的机器或影响计费的操作会标记为破坏性操作，执行前可与你确认。购买需在我们的结账页面完成，不能在聊天中进行。

payload.name: Not Just You
payload.description: AI 服务状态，来源分开呈现
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check AI service status across official provider notices, community reports, and opt-in installed-client signals. Sources stay separate so you can compare the evidence yourself.
Read-only, no account required, and never reads prompts, files, credentials, or messages.
payload.longDescription:
通过官方服务商公告、社区报告和用户自愿提供的已安装客户端信号，查看 AI 服务状态。各来源分别呈现，方便你自行比较证据。
只读，无需账户，且绝不读取提示词、文件、凭据或消息。

payload.name: Swigs Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Swigs Cloud puts your project online in a single sentence. Give it a GitHub repository: the connector detects the framework, builds the project and publishes it over HTTPS on servers located Switzerland. You can then check the status of your sites, read deployment logs, manage environment variables and roll back to a previous version without leaving the conversation. Your data never leaves Swiss territory, backups included, and prices are in Swiss francs.
payload.longDescription: 只需一句话，Swigs Cloud 就能将你的项目上线。提供 GitHub 仓库后，连接器会识别框架、构建项目，并通过位于瑞士的服务器以 HTTPS 发布。之后，你可以直接在对话中查看网站状态、阅读部署日志、管理环境变量，并回滚到之前的版本。你的数据始终留在瑞士境内，备份也不例外；价格以瑞士法郎计价。

payload.name: GraphOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Apollo's official documentation, read documentation pages, and use the Apollo Connectors specification. Sign in to inspect GraphOS graphs, including variants, launches, lint results, persisted query status, and operation, client, and subgraph metrics.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Apollo 官方文档、阅读文档页面并使用 Apollo Connectors 规范。登录后可检查 GraphOS 图谱，包括变体、发布、lint 检查结果、持久化查询状态，以及操作、客户端和子图指标。

Understand public API authentication, pagination, errors, request limits, versioning and privacy boundaries while building an integration. This documentation connection does not retrieve advertisements, access accounts, place bids or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中阅读已发布的 nowyourlink 开发者文档。构建集成时了解公共 API 的身份验证、分页、错误、请求限制、版本控制和隐私边界。此文档连接不会检索广告、访问账户、出价或处理付款。

payload.name: Shopify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Shopify for ChatGPT makes starting, running, and growing an online store as easy as having a conversation. Turn a small business idea into an ecommerce website with Shopify’s AI store builder: describe what you sell, create your store, add products, and sell online. Already have a Shopify store? Connect it to manage inventory across locations, create discount codes, review orders and customer details, and pull analytics on your store’s performance. Shopify supports selling online, in person, B2B, on marketplaces, and selling internationally. Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.
payload.longDescription: Shopify for ChatGPT 让开设、运营和发展网店像对话一样简单。使用 Shopify 的 AI 商店构建工具，将小生意的想法转化为电商网站：描述所售商品，创建商店，添加产品，然后在线销售。已有 Shopify 商店？连接后即可管理各地点的库存、创建折扣码、查看订单和客户详情，并获取商店经营表现的分析数据。Shopify 支持线上销售、线下销售、B2B、在交易平台销售以及国际销售。无论你经营按需印刷业务、销售数字产品、运营精品网店、采用一件代发，还是服务批发买家，Shopify 都能为你提供搭建业务、开展销售和实现增长的基础。

payload.name: HubSpot
payload.description: 在 HubSpot 中将洞察转化为行动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with your HubSpot data to analyze patterns, create and update records, and manage your CRM operations. Read from and write to deals, contacts, companies, tickets, engagements, and other objects you have permission to access. Prepare reports, update deal stages, log calls and emails, create tasks, or review pipeline details before meetings. Use it for quick updates in chat or comprehensive CRM management, all grounded in your actual HubSpot data. Learn more: https://knowledge.hubspot.com/integrations/connect-your-hubspot-account-to-chatgpt
payload.longDescription: 利用 HubSpot 数据分析规律、创建和更新记录，并管理 CRM 运营。读取和写入你有权限访问的交易、联系人、公司、工单、互动记录及其他对象。准备报告、更新交易阶段、记录通话和邮件、创建任务，或在会议前查看销售管道详情。既可在聊天中快速更新，也可全面管理 CRM，所有操作都基于你的实际 HubSpot 数据。了解更多：https://knowledge.hubspot.com/integrations/connect-your-hubspot-account-to-chatgpt

payload.name: Windsor.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsor.ai connects your marketing and business data sources to your AI assistant, so you can ask questions and take action in plain English.

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions across every connected ad account
- Find and pause an underperforming Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads campaign
- Post or reply as your Instagram, Threads, Facebook, or Google Business Profile account
- Pull GA4, Google Search Console, or YouTube Analytics data straight into the conversation
- Sync HubSpot, Salesforce, or Shopify records
- Update a Klaviyo flow or an Amazon Seller Central listing

Connects to 350+ sources across advertising, analytics, organic social, CRM, e-commerce, email, and payments, including Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Company Pages, Microsoft Ads (Bing), GA4, Google Search Console, YouTube, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Google Merchant Center, Stripe, and GoHighLevel.

Reading data only requires connecting the relevant account once. Making a change (pausing a campaign, posting content, replying to a review) always asks for your confirmation first, and it is only available on platforms Windsor explicitly supports write access for. Every other connected source is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription:
Windsor.ai 将营销和业务数据源连接到你的 AI 助手，让你可以用日常英语提问并执行操作。

它可以从任何已连接的数据源获取表现数据，也可以在支持的广告和营销平台上直接进行修改，例如暂停或启用广告活动、设置预算、创建 Google Business Profile 帖子或回复评价；这些修改始终会在你确认后才执行。

常见工作流：
- 比较所有已连接广告账户的花费、点击和转化
- 找出并暂停表现不佳的 Meta Ads、Google Ads、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads 或 Microsoft Ads 广告活动
- 以你的 Instagram、Threads、Facebook 或 Google Business Profile 账户发布内容或回复
- 将 GA4、Google Search Console 或 YouTube Analytics 数据直接引入对话
- 同步 HubSpot、Salesforce 或 Shopify 记录
- 更新 Klaviyo 流程或 Amazon Seller Central 商品页面

连接广告、分析、自然流量社交媒体、CRM、电商、邮件和支付领域的 350+ 个数据源，包括 Google Ads、Meta (Facebook) Ads、Instagram、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads、LinkedIn Company Pages、Microsoft Ads (Bing)、GA4、Google Search Console、YouTube、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Shopify、Klaviyo、Amazon Ads、Google Merchant Center、Stripe 和 GoHighLevel。

读取数据只需连接一次相关账户。任何修改操作（暂停广告活动、发布内容、回复评价）都会先要求你确认，而且仅适用于 Windsor 明确支持写入权限的平台。其他所有已连接数据源均为只读。提供免费套餐，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台不存在关联，也未获这些平台背书。

payload.name: vidIQ
payload.description: 在 YouTube、IG 和 TikTok 上增长
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next video idea, learn from other creators, and improve your content with vidIQ in ChatGPT.

With vidIQ, you can:

• Find ideas and study competitors: discover videos outperforming their creators’ usual results on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. Find similar YouTube channels and explore their uploads.

• Check demand before filming: compare YouTube keyword search estimates and competition, explore related terms, and see views-per-hour trends where available.

• Understand your channel and audience: review YouTube views, watch time, retention and traffic sources. Explore comments for questions and ideas for your next video.

• Learn from other videos: break down hooks, structure and key moments with YouTube transcripts and visual analysis of videos, Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikToks.

• Improve your titles and thumbnails: get feedback on YouTube titles and thumbnails, generate alternative titles, and compare vidIQ scores before choosing what to test.

• Create and repurpose content: write scripts, generate creative assets, and turn long videos into vertical clips for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 vidIQ，寻找下一个视频创意、向其他创作者学习并改进内容。

借助 vidIQ，你可以：

• 寻找创意并研究竞争者：发现 YouTube、Instagram 和 TikTok 上表现超出创作者平常水平的视频。寻找相似的 YouTube 频道，并探索其上传内容。

• 拍摄前验证需求：比较 YouTube 关键词的预估搜索量和竞争程度，探索相关词，并在有数据时查看每小时观看量趋势。

• 了解频道和受众：查看 YouTube 观看次数、观看时长、留存率和流量来源。从评论中寻找问题和下一个视频的创意。

• 学习其他视频：利用 YouTube 文字稿，以及对视频、Shorts、Instagram Reels 和 TikTok 视频的视觉分析，拆解吸引观众的开场、结构和关键时刻。

• 改进标题和缩略图：获取 YouTube 标题和缩略图反馈，生成备选标题，并在选择测试方案前比较 vidIQ 评分。

• 创作和改编内容：撰写脚本、生成创意素材，将长视频转为适用于 YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels 和 TikTok 的竖屏短片。

payload.name: Adspirer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adspirer connects your Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and TikTok Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can manage advertising in plain language. payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MailerLite helps users manage subscribers, groups, campaigns, forms, segments, webhooks, automations, templates, and e-commerce marketing data through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: MailerLite 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 管理订阅者、群组、营销活动、表单、细分、Webhook、自动化、模板和电商营销数据。

payload.name: RocketReach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect RocketReach so you can find and verify professional contact data from a single conversation. Search across 700M+ professionals worldwide to surface key decision makers, then look them up to reveal verified emails, phone numbers, and social profiles. Enrich contacts and companies with details like funding, headcount, growth, and tech stack, and build targeted lists for sales, marketing, and recruiting, all without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: 连接 RocketReach 后，你可以在一次对话中查找并验证专业人士的联系信息。搜索全球 700M+ 专业人士，找到关键决策者，再查询其已验证的电子邮件、电话号码和社交资料。补充联系人和公司的融资、员工人数、增长情况、技术栈等信息，并创建用于销售、营销和招聘的定向名单，全程无需离开聊天。

payload.name: Songstats
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Songstats helps authorized artists, labels, collaborators, and teams inspect current and historical music performance, audience geography, catalogs, tracks, playlists, curators, locations, and source-level trends in ChatGPT. Enterprise-backed lookups preserve Songstats access controls and update the member's normal request or search accounting.
payload.longDescription: Songstats 帮助已获授权的艺人、唱片公司、合作伙伴和团队在 ChatGPT 中查看当前及历史音乐表现、受众地理分布、曲库、曲目、播放列表、策展人、地点和来源级趋势。由企业账户授权的数据查询会保留 Songstats 的访问控制，并计入成员常规的请求或搜索用量。

payload.name: Supermetrics Marketing Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT directly to your marketing and analytics data with Supermetrics.
Query data from platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, Instagram, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok, Shopify, Amazon and more.

The Supermetrics MCP server enables secure, real-time access to your marketing data sources, allowing you to:

-Retrieve campaign performance metrics instantly
-Compare cross-channel results
-Generate marketing reports with live data
-Analyze trends and anomalies
-Create new marketing campaigns or edit existing ones

Built on Supermetrics’ trusted data infrastructure, this integration ensures accurate, governed, and up-to-date marketing data inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: Maersk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Maersk helps users track ocean containers and bookings, air cargo, ground shipments, LCL cargo, and parcels, and browse Maersk schedules for ocean shipment planning. The app returns current shipment milestones, locations, estimated timing when available, tracking widgets for supported transport types, and an interactive schedules widget whose interface loads from the app's own origin.
payload.longDescription: Maersk 帮助用户追踪海运集装箱和订舱、空运货物、陆运货物、拼箱货物及包裹，并浏览 Maersk 船期以规划海运。应用会返回当前运输节点、地点，以及可获取的预计时间；还为支持的运输类型提供追踪小组件，并提供一个交互式船期小组件，其界面从应用自身来源加载。

payload.name: Intuit Mailchimp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Go from business goals to omnichannel campaigns in seconds. Share your goals and get a data backed strategy with ready to use layouts that keep your brand consistent and save time.

Want to understand your campaign performance and where to improve? Ask a question to instantly see what is driving results, what needs attention, and why, all based on your real data.

Ready to send? Connect or create a Mailchimp account to import your assets and reach your audience.
payload.longDescription:
几秒钟内从业务目标生成全渠道营销活动。分享目标即可获得由真实数据支持的策略和可直

接使用的版式，保持品牌一致并节省时间。询问活动表现，立即了解哪些因素推动结果、哪

里需要关注以及原因。连接或创建
 Mailchimp 账户即可导入素材并触达受众。

payload.name: Instantly.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instantly.ai helps users manage Instantly.ai email accounts, campaigns, leads, inbox activity, analytics, and background jobs through ChatGPT. The app supports listing and inspecting workspace data, creating and updating campaigns and lead lists, importing and moving leads, managing sender accounts, replying to email threads, verifying email deliverability, and checking campaign or warmup performance.
payload.longDescription: Instantly.ai 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 管理 Instantly.ai 邮件账户、营销活动、潜在客户、收件箱动态、分析数据和后台作业。该应用支持列出并检查工作区数据、创建和更新营销活动及潜在客户名单、导入和移动潜在客户、管理发件人账户、回复邮件对话、验证邮件送达能力，以及检查营销活动或预热表现。

payload.name: Attio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Attio connects ChatGPT directly to your CRM workspace, letting you manage customer relationships through natural conversation. 

Search and filter contacts, companies, and deals with flexible queries. Create, update, and organize records without switching between screens. Add notes, manage tasks, and track your sales pipeline—all through simple requests. 

Key capabilities: 
- Search records using powerful filters (find companies by size, industry, last contact date) 
- Create and update people, companies, and deal records 
- Manage notes attached to any record 
- Track and complete tasks 
- Navigate lists and organize your data 

Whether you're preparing for a meeting, updating deal stages, or researching prospects, Attio brings your CRM data into your conversation — no manual data entry required.
payload.longDescription:
Attio 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到你的CRM工作区，让你通过自然对话管理客户关系。

使用灵活查询搜索和筛选联系人、公司及交易。无需切换屏幕，即可创建、更新和整理记录。通过简单请求添加笔记、管理任务并跟踪销售机会管道。

主要功能：
- 使用强大的筛选条件搜索记录（按规模、行业、最后联系日期查找公司）
- 创建和更新人员、公司及交易记录
- 管理附加到任何记录的笔记
- 跟踪并完成任务
- 浏览列表并整理数据

无论你在准备会议、更新交易阶段还是研究潜在客户，Attio 都能将CRM数据带入对话——无需手动录入数据。

payload.name: Close
payload.description: 通过 ChatGPT 使用 Close CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Close stores every call, email, SMS, and meeting your team touches, not just contact records. Connect it to ChatGPT and your conversation history becomes something you can actually work from.

Ask ChatGPT to catch you up on a deal, summarize recent calls, draft follow-ups, update records, or build outreach workflows without bouncing between tools. Close is built around communication. Calls, emails, SMS, and meetings are all logged and searchable, giving ChatGPT far more context than traditional CRMs built mostly for record-keeping.

Close also includes Chloe, a built-in AI sales teammate embedded directly into your workflows. Together, ChatGPT and Chloe help teams stay on top of follow-up, prioritize outreach, and keep deals moving.
payload.longDescription:
Close 会保存团队参与的每次通话、邮件、短信和会议记录，而不仅仅是联系人记录。将它连接到 ChatGPT 后，你的对话历史就能真正用于工作。

你可以让 ChatGPT 帮你快速了解一笔交易、总结近期通话、起草跟进内容、更新记录或构建外联工作流，无需在不同工具之间来回切换。Close 围绕沟通构建。通话、邮件、短信和会议都会被记录并可供搜索，因此 ChatGPT 能获得比主要用于记录信息的传统 CRM 丰富得多的上下文。

Close 还包含内置的 AI 销售伙伴 Chloe，直接嵌入你的工作流。ChatGPT 与 Chloe 协同，帮助团队跟进后续事项、确定外联优先级并推动交易进展。

payload.name: Upwork
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upwork connects clients hiring for work with the freelancers doing it. Clients can post jobs, review proposals, send offers, message freelancers, and manage contracts, milestones, and payments. Freelancers can search and save jobs, submit proposals, respond to invitations and offers, track earnings and time reports, and manage their public profile. Both sides get a consolidated dashboard of what's new.
payload.longDescription: Upwork 将招聘客户与自由职业者连接起来。客户可以发布工作、查看提案、发送邀约、给自由职业者发消息，并管理合同、里程碑和付款。自由职业者可以搜索和保存职位、提交提案、回复邀请和邀约、跟踪收入和工时报告，并管理公开个人资料。双方都能在统一仪表板中查看最新动态。

payload.name: ActiveCampaign
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You already work in ChatGPT. Now drive and track your marketing outcomes there too.
Connect ActiveCampaign in a few clicks. From the chat, you can:

- Understand yesterday's campaign performance in seconds
- Look up a contact and update their information.
- Clean up tags, build segments, and organize your lists.
- Move deals forward without leaving ChatGPT.
- Enroll a contact in automated marketing workflows.

No new tab. No copy paste. No starting over. ChatGPT is the surface you ask from. ActiveCampaign takes action.
payload.longDescription:
你已经在 ChatGPT 中工作，现在也可以在这里推动并跟踪营销成果。
点击几次即可连接 ActiveCampaign。在聊天中，你可以：

- 几秒内了解昨天的营销活动表现
- 查找联系人并更新其信息。
- 清理标签、建立细分群组并整理列表。
- 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可推进交易。
- 将联系人加入自动化营销工作流程。

无需新开标签页，无需复制粘贴，无需从头再来。你在 ChatGPT 中提出请求，ActiveCampaign 负责执行。

payload.name: SE Ranking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SE Ranking connects ChatGPT to SE Ranking's SEO data and project APIs. Research keywords, analyze backlinks and referring domains, study domain and competitor traffic, pull live SERP data, run website audits, track AI Search visibility across ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/AI Overview, and manage rank-tracking projects you own.
payload.longDescription: SE Ranking 将 ChatGPT 连接到 SE Ranking 的 SEO 数据和项目 API。研究关键词、分析反向链接和引荐域名、研究域名及竞争对手流量、获取实时 SERP 数据、执行网站审计、追踪 ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/AI Overview 中的 AI 搜索可见度，并管理你拥有的排名追踪项目。

payload.name: HoneyBook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HoneyBook is where independent businesses and lean teams run their client work: inquiries, proposals, contracts, invoices, payments and the messages in between.

Connect your account and work through a whole job in one conversation. Ask which leads are worth chasing and get a ranked answer from your own bookings. Have the proposal built from your saved template. Review it before it goes anywhere. Later, ask who still owes you money, and raise a payment request for whoever does.

You approve what it can reach before anything runs, resource by resource, and nothing reaches a client until you send it. Each request runs in an isolated environment, and your credentials are never shared with the model.

Built for photographers, event planners, venues, designers and consultants. Requires a HoneyBook account.
payload.longDescription:
HoneyBook 为独立经营者和精简团队提供管理客户工作的场所：咨询、提案、合同、发票、付款，以及各环节之间的消息沟通。

连接账户后，在一次对话中处理完整业务。询问哪些潜在客户值得跟进，它会根据你自己的已预约业务给出排序结果。使用已保存的模板生成提案，并在发出前审阅。之后，可以询问谁还欠款，并向欠款客户发起付款请求。

任何操作运行前，你需要逐项批准它可访问的资源；只有你发送后，内容才会到达客户。每项请求都在隔离环境中运行，你的凭据绝不会共享给模型。

专为摄影师、活动策划人员、场地经营者、设计师和顾问打造。需要 HoneyBook 账户。

payload.name: Sanity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create, query, and manage your structured content in Sanity directly from ChatGPT. Run content audits, update documents, coordinate releases, and find anything across your projects. Or set up entirely new projects – schemas, content, and configuration – just by chatting.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中创建、查询和管理 Sanity 结构化内容。执行内容审核、更新文档、协调发布，并在项目中查找任何内容。也可以只通过聊天设置全新的项目，包括 schema、内容和配置。

payload.name: Planning Center
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Planning Center to ChatGPT to interact with your ministry data through natural conversation. Each user connects with their own account, so ChatGPT only sees what their Planning Center permissions allow.
payload.longDescription: 将 Planning Center 连接到 ChatGPT，通过自然对话使用您的事工数据。每位用户都连接自己的账户，因此 ChatGPT 只能查看该用户 Planning Center 权限所允许的数据。

payload.name: Windsor.ai Google Ads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Google Ads helps marketers analyze live Google Ads performance. Users can discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and segmentation options, query campaign, ad group, and keyword metrics, connect the Google Ads connector, and safely run supported Google Ads actions such as creating, pausing, enabling, and updating campaigns, ad groups, ads, and keywords, setting budgets, managing bidding, and managing Customer Match audience lists, after confirmation. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Google Ads 帮助营销人员分析实时 Google Ads 成效。用户可以发现已连接的广告账户、查看有效字段和细分选项、查询广告系列、广告组和关键字指标、连接 Google Ads 连接器，并在确认后安全执行受支持的 Google Ads 操作，例如创建、暂停、启用和更新广告系列、广告组、广告和关键字，设置预算、管理出价以及管理 Customer Match 受众名单。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Business Strategy Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your business idea into a clear, shareable strategy.
Use this whether you are starting a new business or sharpening an existing one.
It helps you find the right words to explain what you do, for whom, and why it matters.
That gives you clarity for yourself before you bring others in.
It also helps you make real choices and trade-offs instead of keeping everything open.
You work toward a complete Business Strategy Canvas that fits on one page.
This one-page canvas becomes a simple reference you can use to align decisions and priorities.
At the end, you can export a PPTX presentation to share with co-founders, teammates, clients, or stakeholders.
Use the PPTX to pitch, get buy-in, or kick off a strategy session with everyone on the same page.
If your thinking feels scattered, this turns it into something you can communicate and act on.
payload.longDescription:
将您的商业想法转化为清晰、可分享的策略。无论您是在创办新企业，还是在打磨现有企业，都可以使用它。它帮助您找到合适的语言，说明您做什么、为谁做以及为什么重要，从而在引入他人前先获得自己的清晰认识。它还帮助您做出真实的选择和权衡，而不是让所有选项一直开放。
您将逐步完成一页纸的商业策略画布。这张画布可作为对齐决策和优先级的简单参考。最后，您可以导出 PPTX 演示文稿，与联合创始人、队友、客户或利益相关者分享。用 PPTX 做展示、争取支持，或在所有人目标一致的情况下启动策略会议。如果您的思路杂乱，它会把思路变成可沟通、可行动的方案。

payload.name: Windsor.ai Search Console
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Google Search Console helps SEOs and marketers explore live Search Console data. Users can discover connected Search Console sites, inspect valid dimensions and metrics, and query organic search performance — clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position by query, page, country, device, and date — over any date range, and connect the Search Console connector. It provides read-only analytics: it does not run write actions, submit or change sitemaps, or modify any Search Console settings. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Google Search Console 帮助 SEO 人员和营销人员查看实时 Search Console 数据。用户可以发现已连接的 Search Console 网站，查看有效维度和指标，并按任意日期范围查询自然搜索表现——按查询词、页面、国家/地区、设备和日期细分的点击次数、展示次数、点击率（CTR）和平均排名——还可连接 Search Console 连接器。它提供只读分析：不会执行写入操作、提交或更改站点地图，也不会修改任何 Search Console 设置。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Clutch.co
payload.description: 寻找理想的 B2B 合作伙伴
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Clutch.co brings trusted B2B service provider research and verified client reviews into ChatGPT, helping you confidently find and compare agencies, consultants, and software partners. Discover thousands of vetted companies across marketing, development, design, IT services, and more—each backed by in-depth profiles and detailed feedback from real clients.

Ask questions like “Which digital marketing agencies have the best reviews for SaaS companies?” or “Compare top web development firms based on client satisfaction,” and Clutch highlights review insights, strengths and weaknesses, pricing signals, and relevant experience. Refine your shortlist through natural conversation and make more informed B2B decisions with transparent, review-driven insights—right inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Clutch.co 将可信的 B2B 服务提供商研究和经过验证的客户评价带入 ChatGPT，帮助您自信地寻找和比较代理机构、顾问和软件合作伙伴。发现营销、开发、设计、IT 服务等领域数千家经过审核的公司，每家公司都有详细档案和真实客户反馈。

您可以问：“哪些数字营销机构最适合 SaaS 公司且评价最好？”或“根据客户满意度比较顶尖网页开发公司。”Clutch 会突出评价洞察、优势和弱点、价格信号及相关经验。通过自然对话完善候选名单，借助透明、以评价为基础的洞察，在 ChatGPT 内做出更明智的 B2B 决策。

payload.name: Wialon
payload.description: 随时询问你的车队情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore your fleet data effortlessly through conversation. Wialon — the ultimate fleet digitalization solution tracking 4 million vehicles in 160 countries — brings your real-time operational insights directly into ChatGPT.

Simply ask questions about your vehicle statuses, trips, fuel activity, or geofences, and get clear, visual answers in seconds. It’s a faster, more intuitive way to stay on top of your operations, right where you already chat.

The app is read-only by design, ensuring a secure and transparent way to explore your data at any time.
payload.longDescription:
通过对话轻松探索车队数据。Wialon 是一款车队数字化解决方案，追踪 160 个国家/地区的 4 million 辆车辆，可将实时运营洞察直接带入 ChatGPT。

只需询问车辆状态、行程、燃油活动或地理围栏，即可在几秒钟内获得清晰直观的答案。无需离开熟悉的聊天界面，就能以更快捷、更直观的方式掌握运营情况。

该应用在设计上仅提供只读访问，让你随时以安全、透明的方式探索数据。

payload.name: Upload-Post
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upload-Post helps users publish, schedule, analyze, and manage social media posts from ChatGPT. It supports video, photo, text, and document publishing; scheduling and queue management; analytics; profile management; Instagram comments and DMs; browser-based media staging; and FFmpeg media processing across connected social platforms.
payload.longDescription: Upload-Post 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中发布、安排、分析和管理社交媒体帖子。它支持发布视频、照片、文本和文档；安排发布并管理队列；查看分析数据；管理个人资料；处理 Instagram 评论和私信；通过浏览器暂存媒体；以及在已连接的社交平台上使用 FFmpeg 处理媒体。

payload.name: Tailwind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tailwind helps users generate Pinterest Pin drafts from webpages, browse connected accounts, boards, board lists and board sections, create and manage boards, research public Pinterest group boards by topic, review drafts and recommended posting times, check an account's subscription status, manage a saved keywords list, schedule Pins, edit the copy on drafts and scheduled Pins, and delete unpublished Pins through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Tailwind 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 从网页生成 Pinterest Pin 草稿，浏览已连接的账户、画板、画板列表和分区，创建和管理画板，按主题研究公开的 Pinterest 群组画板，查看草稿和推荐发布时间，检查账户订阅状态，管理已保存的关键词列表，安排 Pin 发布，编辑草稿和已排期 Pin 的文案，并删除尚未发布的 Pin。

payload.name: AdKit - Ads Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AdKit connects your ad accounts to ChatGPT so you can manage advertising in plain language. 

Analyze campaign performance, create campaign drafts, research competitor ads, and generate ad creatives across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Reddit Ads workflows. 

Changes stay draft-first for review and only publish after explicit approval, so ChatGPT can help you move faster without silently changing live campaigns.
payload.longDescription:
AdKit 将广告账户连接至 ChatGPT，让你用自然语言管理广告。

在 Google Ads、Meta Ads、TikTok Ads 和 Reddit Ads 工作流程中，分析营销活动表现、创建活动草稿、研究竞争对手广告并生成广告创意。

变更会先保留为草稿供审核，仅在明确批准后发布，让 ChatGPT 帮你更快推进工作，而不会悄然修改正在投放的活动。

payload.name: Twenty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Twenty helps users work with their CRM workspace from ChatGPT by discovering available tools, learning tool schemas, searching Twenty documentation, loading workspace skills, and executing permitted CRM actions such as finding, creating, updating, or deleting records and drafting or sending email when the user's role allows it.
payload.longDescription: Twenty 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用 CRM 工作区：发现可用工具、了解工具架构、搜索 Twenty 文档、加载工作区技能，并执行获准的 CRM 操作，例如查找、创建、更新或删除记录，以及在用户角色获准时起草或发送电子邮件。

payload.name: Nifty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Nifty to ChatGPT to analyze and organize your reselling business across every marketplace you sell on. ChatGPT can search and filter inventory, pull full item details and photos, check inventory health, manage favorites, private notes, and labels, review order history and expenses, edit items and update marketplace listings, and analyze sales, profit, and sell-through. Nifty unifies inventory and sales for resellers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, and Whatnot.
